# Holarse — native Linux installation and save problems

- Original source: [Holarse — native Linux installation and save problems](https://holarse.de/wiki/robin_hood_die_legende_von_sherwood)
- Author / publication: comrad and Holarse contributors; latest displayed edit by Linux Gamer 91
- Language / date: German; created 2008-06-17, last displayed edit 2019-12-07
- Access: Page text inspected; linked installer and troubleshooting pages not retrieved
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

Holarse documents the native Linux edition, an updated CD installer, and separate PowerPC binary links. Its installer example identifies a 1.2 multilingual x86 package dated 2012-11-02 and still requires the original disc.

The troubleshooting section reports saves that cause repeatable crashes after loading and points to a longer explanation elsewhere. That explanation could not be retrieved, so neither a root cause nor a repair procedure is established here.

This is a historical community report, not a test of current packages. No installer or binary was executed. Compare its save symptoms with the separate MorphOS reports before assuming a shared defect.
